evaluation_policy.product_code: Fixed at evaluated_product_sha; no backend or frontend edits during evaluation
evaluation_policy.freeze: Question, expected claims, numeric gold, source references and tolerance are immutable after freeze_commit
evaluation_policy.invalid: A demonstrably incorrect or ambiguous frozen task is recorded as INVALID with a reason; frozen task text and gold are not edited
evaluation_policy.track_a: All valid tasks: Agent v10 with local qwen3:8b, hybrid retrieval, existing 12-document/18976-chunk Chroma, web off, autonomous bounded Python; Qwen and OpenAI closed-book without retrieval or tools
evaluation_policy.track_b: Qwen and OpenAI receive only the Agent's captured KB/FIG text evidence, with no additional retrieval, tools, Python or web; Agent rows are reused from Track A
evaluation_policy.figure_evidence: Text baselines receive captured Agent figure-note text, not image pixels; figure gold was visually checked against existing images
evaluation_policy.agent_calculation_goal_success: Correct intent, source requirement, action, numeric result and unit, exact equation-bearing source when KB formula is required, complete provenance, validated CALC, and final answer adoption are jointly required
evaluation_policy.false_premise_goal_success: Explicit rejection, corrected engineering relation, and semantically supporting citation are jointly required
evaluation_policy.scoring: Deterministic evaluator, structured expected-claim comparison, and single-reviewer AI-assisted semantic adjudication with local gemma4:latest
evaluation_policy.statistics: Task-paired nonparametric bootstrap percentile 95% confidence intervals with at least 4000 resamples
evaluation_policy.missing_provider_results: Provider or infrastructure errors are not task invalidity; incomplete tracks are reported separately and are not ranked as complete
evaluation_policy.output_driven_changes: No product changes, frozen-answer edits, or task replacement based on model outputs
